sources.title: Gouvernement de la République du Sénégal

capital.evidence_quote: Dakar is the capital, largest city, and principal Atlantic seaport of the Republic of Senegal

sources.title: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest

currency.evidence_quote: The West African CFA Franc (XOF, CFA) is the legal currency pegged to the Euro (1 EUR = 655.957 XOF)

sources.title: Agence Nationale de l'Aviation Civile et de la Météorologie

timezone.evidence_quote: Senegal observes Greenwich Mean Time (UTC+0) year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: National single-phase household power supply voltage across Senegal is 230V at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Senelec electrical grid operates at a nominal frequency of 50 Hz alternating current

plug_types.evidence_quote: Europlug Types C and E are most prevalent in residences, with D and K encountered in legacy buildings

police.evidence_quote: Dial 17 for Police Nationale (urban) or 800 00 20 20 for Gendarmerie emergency calls

sources.title: Ministère de la Santé du Sénégal

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 15 (or SAMU 15 15) for emergency medical ambulance and hospital transit

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 18 to dispatch the Brigade Nationale des Sapeurs-Pompiers emergency fire and rescue units

general.evidence_quote: Dial 112 nationwide from any mobile phone for emergency services routing

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Standart Önlemler (Genel Olarak Güvenli ve Sakin; Casamance Kırsalında Dikkat)
advisory_headline.en: Exercise Normal Precautions (Generally Safe & Hospitable; Caution in Rural Casamance)
advisory_headline.de: Normale Vorsicht (Allgemein sicher und gastfreundlich; Vorsicht im ländlichen Casamance)
advisory_headline.ru: Стандартные меры предосторожности (В целом безопасно; осторожность в сельском Казамансе)
advisory_headline.es: Precauciones normales (Generalmente seguro y hospitalario; precaución en Casamance rural)

regional_warnings.area: Casamance rural interior outside main highways
regional_warnings.reason: Occasional landmine risk in off-road forested tracts; stick to paved coastal and transit routes

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Senegal registers median mobile broadband speeds around 31.2 Mbps on Orange and Free 4G/5G

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Senegalese fixed broadband infrastructure yields median download speeds of approximately 26.4 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: SIM cards easily purchased with passport at Dakar AIBD airport or city shops via Orange, Free, or Expresso; Wave and Orange Money handle all daily cashless payments
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Telecommunications authority mandates identity identification for all active mobile SIM lines

religion.value: Islam (Sufi brotherhoods: Mouride, Tijaniyya ~95%), Christianity (~4%), traditional beliefs
religion.evidence_quote: Over 94% of Senegalese citizens adhere to Islam, famed for exemplary interfaith tolerance and peace

festivals.value: Grand Magal de Touba, Korité (Eid al-Fitr), Tabaski (Eid al-Adha), Saint-Louis Jazz Festival, Dakar Biennale (Dak'Art)

sources.title: Ministère de la Culture du Sénégal

festivals.evidence_quote: Grand Magal and Saint-Louis Jazz Festival highlight the religious and artistic vibrancy of Senegal

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Embrace the ethos of 'Teranga' (warm hospitality); ask permission before photographing people; dress respectfully when visiting religious towns like Touba (no smoking or alcohol permitted); drug offenses carry severe penalties
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Teranga represents national spirit of welcome; conservative etiquette enforced strictly in holy cities

tipping.value: Appreciated in cafes and restaurants (5-10%); rounding up fares for taxi drivers and tipping hotel porters is standard courtesy
tipping.evidence_quote: Gratuities are voluntary but warmly accepted across the tourist and restaurant industry
